name: IC 3487 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 3487, an elliptical galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: vcc1488-hubble
story: IC 3487 is one of 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster that Hubble imaged for the ACS Virgo Cluster Survey. The survey studied the globular clusters around each galaxy and measured distances from the subtle graininess of their starlight.

claims.text: VCC 1488 is IC 3487, morphological type E6:
E types in the sample are elliptical galaxies
The ACS Virgo Cluster Survey imaged 100 early-type galaxies in the Virgo Cluster
The survey studies globular clusters and measures distances with surface brightness fluctuations
